mapper.select: -- 分页查询父回复 SELECT r.id, r.content, r.user_id AS userId, r.post_id AS postId, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.parent_id AS parentId, u.username, u.image FROM replies r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.post_id = #{postid} AND r.status = 0 AND r.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY r.created_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.content, r.user_id AS userId, r.post_id AS postId, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.parent_id AS parentId, u.username, u.image FROM replies r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.content, r.user_id AS userId, r.post_id AS postId, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.parent_id AS parentId, u.username, u.image FROM replies r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.parent_id = #{replyid} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
mapper.insert: insert into replies(content, user_id, post_id, created_time,updated_time,parent_id) values (#{content}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{parentId})
mapper.update:
UPDATE replies
like_count = #{likeCount},
content = #{content},
status = #{status},
updated_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
